g.text: SNAP Mini Power Controller: solar charger + power distribution for a handheld LoRa mesh node, 20 x 12 mm, two M2 holes. No net carries more than 1 A.

g.desc: SNAP Mini Power Controller: solar charger + power distribution for a handheld LoRa mesh node, 20 x 12 mm, two M2 holes. No net carries more than 1 A.

g.text: - J4 SOLAR: 5V panel, 1 = VIN, 2 = GND. CN3163 input 4.4-6V, absolute max 6.5V: panel Voc must stay below 6.5V.

g.desc: - J4 SOLAR: 5V panel, 1 = VIN, 2 = GND. CN3163 input 4.4-6V, absolute max 6.5V: panel Voc must stay below 6.5V.

g.text: - U1 CN3163 linear charger, 4.2V float (FB = BAT), ICH = 1188V / R1 = 0.99A, cut back automatically when the panel

g.desc: - U1 CN3163 linear charger, 4.2V float (FB = BAT), ICH = 1188V / R1 = 0.99A, cut back automatically when the panel

g.text: sags toward 4.4V and by thermal regulation (~130C die). TEMP grounded (no NTC).

g.desc: sags toward 4.4V and by thermal regulation (~130C die). TEMP grounded (no NTC).

g.text: - D1 red = charging (~CHRG low), D2 green = charge done (~DONE low). Both fed from VIN: dark without sun.

g.desc: - D1 red = charging (~CHRG low), D2 green = charge done (~DONE low). Both fed from VIN: dark without sun.

g.text: - J1 BATTERY: 1S Li-ion, 1 = BAT+, 2 = GND. The charger feeds BAT+ directly, so the cell charges with the switch open.

g.desc: - J1 BATTERY: 1S Li-ion, 1 = BAT+, 2 = GND. The charger feeds BAT+ directly, so the cell charges with the switch open.

g.text: - J2 SWITCH: off-board SPST in series with battery + toward the load. 1 = BAT+, 2 = VOUT.

g.desc: - J2 SWITCH: off-board SPST in series with battery + toward the load. 1 = BAT+, 2 = VOUT.
